none: PAS NLM-9841E5: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of House of Valentinian, probably Victory left issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Reverse description: probably Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRI]TAS REI P[VBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 1.39gms, die axis: probably 12
